notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 - Play With Controller AND Keyboard Simultaneously!🎮⌨️
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce the release of [b]Patch 1.0.1[/b] for [b]Big Helmet Heroes[/b] on PC!

This update brings several key changes, including a highly requested feature: [b]support for both keyboard + mouse and gamepad simultaneously![/b] Now, Player 1 can enjoy the game with their keyboard and mouse while Player 2 joins the action using a gamepad. We hope this makes your co-op experience even more fun and flexible! 🎮

But that’s not all! This patch also includes a variety of other bug fixes and improvements to ensure a smoother experience. Thank you for your continued support guys!

[b][h2]🗒️ Patch Notes 🗒️[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Add support for keyboard + gamepad : you can now play with one controller for the player 2 and the keyboard and mouse for the player 1 (PC VERSION)
[*] Add native support for dualsense (PS5) and dualshock (PS4) controller (PC VERSION)
[*] Add some visual feedback when you can’t use your superpower
[*] Add confirmation pop-up on multiple spots to avoid missclick
[*] Readjust size of apple collider to make it easier to pick up
[*] Add a visual effect when unlocking puzzle cage
[*] Add a visual check icon on the cage that you already found
[*] Fix issues related to checkpoint, enemies should respond correctly if you restart the game from a checkpoint
[*] Fix issues when respawning in co-op making the camera go to some weird location
[*] Fix Steamdeck loading screen cutoff on some resolution
[*] Fix cutscene stretching on some resolution
[*] Fix Multispecter: the specter shouldn’t hit the player anymore
[*] Fix issues where the player couldn’t attack anymore after a slide
[*] Fix issues where the input of superpower was displayed in an area where it’s impossible to trigger a power
[*] Fix issues where the enemy character doesn’t rotate correctly when receiving a hit
[*] Fix issues where the screen after the level 5 was not at the good opacity
[*] Fix issues where the player can be stuck in the ground during a hit by the scorpio boss (runner phase)
[*] Fix issues where selecting random heroes in exalted mode give to the player 2 heroes instead of one
[*] Fix issue where the player could stay in fire forever if they get hit by a frozen effect right after
[*] Fix issue where the player could stay in frozen effect if they get hit by a fire effect right after
[*] Fix input not activated after restarting level if you die when you fall out of the map
[*] Fix 2 players getting same puzzle piece (and same weapon or projectile item) at the same time which was blocking the player in a holding position without having the object in hand, now prevent coop player from grabbing player during a take/grab/throw action and player is uninterruptible when holding a puzzle piece
[*] Fix issues where distance weapons have unlimited ammos after restarting from a checkpoint
[*] Fix issues where weapons and shield didn’t dissolve during enemies death
[*] Fix issues during giant superpower, the player wasn’t invulnerable in some cases
[*] Fix issues in level 13 - a little scorpion staying stuck in one arena avoiding the player to continue
[*] Fix issues with stamina and apple pick-up sound wasn’t playing due to issues with sound spatialisation
[*] Fix a crash that can happen when the player shoots with a distance weapon and takes another weapon at the same time
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019324/053bc02f13feeeb28d103285a9133d5529807d79.jpg[/img]

notes.title: ⭐️ Big Helmet Heroes: Price Reveal ⭐️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019324/06b258f5d7c6534ba7e74d99b13344d0741112f0.png[/img]

[b]Big Helmet Heroes[/b] is launching on [b]February 6th[/b], and we’re excited to share the official pricing details with you. Whether you're a fan of the base game or looking to dive deeper into the world with some awesome extras, we’ve got you covered.

Here’s a breakdown of the pricing:
[list]
[*] [b]Base Game:[/b] 24.99€  
[*][b] Exalted Edition[/b] (Base Game + Artbook + OST): 29.99€  
[*] [b]Artbook [/b]+ [b]OST Bundle[/b]: 5.99€  
[*] [b]Artbook[/b]: 2.99€  
[*] [b]OST[/b]: 2.99€
[/list]
For those eager to jump in early, players who purchase the [b]Exalted Edition[/b] will get an exclusive [b]Early Unlock[/b] starting today at 5:00 PM CET! That’s right! You’ll be able to play the game ahead of the official release on February 6th. Not only will you get access to the full base game, but you’ll also receive a stunning [b]Artbook[/b] and the [b]Original Soundtrack (OST)[/b], two great additions to enhance your Big Helmet Heroes experience. ⭐️

If you're not sure whether to grab the extras, we’ve also made the Artbook and OST available separately, allowing you to choose what suits you best. Whether you're in it for the gameplay or want to immerse yourself in the lore and music, there’s something for everyone.

We can't wait for you to play Big Helmet Heroes! Stay tuned for more updates as we keep improving the game and rolling out fresh content.

And most importantly, HAVE FUN! 😁

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2397250/Big_Helmet_Heroes/

[url=https://discord.gg/DCqReJNuRG]⭐Join our Community on Discord⭐[/url]

notes.title: Big Helmet Heroes - Available Early 2025!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=6sMi67ivzhQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Big Helmet Heroes[/b] is an epic 3D beat’em up adventure that promises to captivate players with its unique blend of challenging gameplay that combines charismatic heroes with unique powers, exhilarating action and beautifully detailed animation. Set to [b]release in early 2025[/b], the game offers a lot to look forward to for fans of beat'em up 3D. If you're eager to get a taste of the action before the full launch, you’re in luck: a [b]demo is available on Steam[/b], and for your friends playing on Xbox, a demo is available as well as part of the [b]Winter Indie Game Fest Demo Event[/b].


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2397250/Big_Helmet_Heroes/

[u][b]Key Features of Big Helmet Heroes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Throw yourself into an epic 3D beat’em up adventure[/b] with adorable knights, full of surprising worlds and situations. Grab your buddy and play in [b]2 player co-op[/b] to save the princess, but this is only the beginning!

[*] [b]Immersive World[/b]: Explore a vast, detailed world filled with unique locations, dungeons, and environments, all crafted with the utmost attention to detail.

[*] [b]Cooperative Play[/b]: Team up with friends to take on challenging quests and formidable bosses. [b]Big Helmet Heroes[/b] brings a cooperative multiplayer experience that lets you and your friends tackle adventures together.
[/list]
[u][b]Focus on the Four Playable Classes[/b][/u]

[b]Big Helmet Heroes[/b] boasts a dynamic class system, allowing players to choose from four unique character classes, each with its own strengths and playstyle. These classes offer deep tactical variety, ensuring no two players have the same experience.

[olist]
[*] [b]Warrior [/b]– A melee powerhouse, the Warrior class excels in close combat with strong defenses and powerful attacks. Ideal for those who prefer to charge into battle headfirst.
  
[*] [b]Monk[/b] – Masters of martial arts and spiritual power, Monks combine quick strikes with elemental abilities. Monks can channel inner energy to perform devastating combos and heal allies, making them a versatile class for both offense and support.
 
[*] [b]Brute[/b] – The Brute is a juggernaut of sheer strength. This class is designed for players who enjoy smashing through enemies with raw power. The Brute can absorb damage and dish out heavy hits, making them perfect for tanking and dealing massive damage in close combat.
    
[*] [b]Rogue [/b]– Quick, stealthy, and deadly, Rogues specialize in sneak attacks and evasion. Their dexterity allows them to disable traps, steal items, and backstab enemies with lethal precision.
[/olist]
Don’t forget to [b]stay tuned for updates as we approach the full release[/b], and get ready to embark on an unforgettable journey when [b]Big Helmet Heroes drops in 2025[/b].
